pet.ember-fox.name: Ember Fox
pet.ember-fox.blurb: Sheds sparks whenever it is pleased with itself, which is why the bedroll now lives in a metal box.
pet.moss-boar.name: Moss Boar
pet.moss-boar.blurb: Wears half a hillside on its back and takes personal offence at anyone who tries to weed it.
pet.thicket-hare.name: Thicket Hare
pet.thicket-hare.blurb: Has never once been where you last looked, and regards this as basic professional courtesy.
pet.ridgeback-wolf.name: Ridgeback Wolf
pet.ridgeback-wolf.blurb: Walks two paces ahead at all times and would like it noted that this is the correct order.
pet.cinder-wisp.name: Cinder Wisp
pet.cinder-wisp.blurb: A very small fire with a very large sense of occasion.
pet.tide-sprite.name: Tide Sprite
pet.tide-sprite.blurb: Arrives twice a day on a schedule only it understands, and leaves everything slightly damp.
pet.pebble-golem.name: Pebble Golem
pet.pebble-golem.blurb: Assembled itself from the good stones and stacked the mediocre ones neatly for somebody else.
pet.storm-mote.name: Storm Mote
pet.storm-mote.blurb: One spark of a storm that never quite came together, and technically still counts as weather.
pet.lantern-ghost.name: Lantern Ghost
pet.lantern-ghost.blurb: Died holding the lantern and has yet to hear a convincing argument for putting it down.
pet.hearth-cherub.name: Hearth Cherub
pet.hearth-cherub.blurb: Guards the fire, the kettle and your habit of coming home, in roughly that order.
pet.dream-moth.name: Dream Moth
pet.dream-moth.blurb: Navigates by the nearest good idea, which is how it keeps ending up in your pack.
pet.grave-owl.name: Grave Owl
pet.grave-owl.blurb: Keeps two registers — those who fell, and those who merely fell over — and the second one is much longer.
pet.snallygaster.name: Snallygaster
pet.snallygaster.blurb: Nobody can agree on what it is, and it has decided not to settle the argument.
pet.fernwyrm.name: Fernwyrm
pet.fernwyrm.blurb: Knows every shortcut under the ferns and is visibly pained by the pace you set.
pet.moon-calf.name: Moon Calf
pet.moon-calf.blurb: Grazes on moonlight, which is free, and on treats, which are emphatically not.
pet.the-gilded-snail.name: The Gilded Snail
pet.the-gilded-snail.blurb: Takes a full season to cross a shop floor, by which point the merchant has agreed to almost anything.
